name: LOA Healthcare Pricing
description: Model Context Protocol server providing AI assistants with access to source-labeled healthcare pricing data, CPT code lookups, provider directories, hospital price transparency data, and Loa-reviewed provider corrections.

tools.name: search_cpt_codes
tools.description: Search for medical procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS) by name, description, or code number

tools.name: suggest_procedures
tools.description: Get AI-powered procedure suggestions from a natural language description

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search for healthcare providers (doctors, specialists) by name, specialty, or location

tools.name: get_pricing_estimate
tools.description: Get estimated costs for medical procedures based on hospital pricing data

tools.name: get_market_pricing
tools.description: Get market average pricing for procedures including cash pay and insurance rates

tools.name: search_hospitals
tools.description: Search for hospitals by location or name

tools.name: get_hospital_pricing
tools.description: Get source-labeled hospital pricing, including Published MRF rates and reviewed provider overlays

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search Loa runtime hospital and provider entity pages by name, state, or type

tools.name: get_entity_profile
tools.description: Get one Loa hospital or provider entity profile by slug or id with field-level provenance

tools.name: get_entity_prices
tools.description: Get Published MRF and Loa Verified Provider Price data for one Loa hospital or provider entity

tools.name: explain_price_sources
tools.description: Explain source labels, confidence, caveats, and comparable MRF prices for one Loa entity

tools.name: submit_entity_update_request
tools.description: Submit a provider or hospital profile, listing, or price correction with contact and source evidence for Loa review
